intent.raw: But the thing is that maybe in the future I'll make mutations to skills, and this could impact the metric, or does it not make sense?
intent.objective: Refine, through the canonical ten-stage loop, a non-executed design for DCI as a controlled skill-mutation regression metric — delta-DCI(skill v_old to v_new) on a fixed workload — establishing version tagging, fixed-workload replay, and observer independence, with a real power analysis on the telemetry, and an explicit block if observer co-mutation cannot be cheaply neutralized; without editing canonical packages.
intent.operator_sentence: Make DCI a before/after regression signal for skill edits, and prove it is not just measuring whether the skill grades itself more leniently.

route_menu.context_hint: Three differential designs could carry the regression metric; the design stage records a route decision over them, ranked by observer-independence.

items.label: Observer-independent ground-truth differential
items.description: Replay a fixed fixture corpus through v_old and v_new and score with observer-independent signals (git file-rework, fixture pass/fail, downstream failure). Survives observer co-mutation.

items.label: Harness replay with bundled observer
items.description: Fixed-workload replay but scored with the skill's own observer; holds workload constant but stays contaminated if the mutation changes reporting.

items.label: Live version-slice
items.description: Slice live telemetry by skill_version; cheapest but neither workload-fixed nor observer-frozen; weakest.

technique_overlays.trigger: Every refine run preserves the canonical ordered loop with safe handoffs and observability.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each non-first stage consumes a prior handoff, stages keep owner boundaries, and trace events group by dispatch_id.

technique_overlays.trigger: The redesign builds on the prior DCI run and its critique (circular self-report, ceiling skew, sigil-identity confound).
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The prior DCI design and critique are cited by path; the differential framing is justified against the named earlier failures.

technique_overlays.trigger: Three differential designs (ground-truth, harness-replay, live-slice) must be compared, ranked by observer-independence and feasibility.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The design stage declares the three differential roles, a pareto criterion over observer-independence, workload control, and cost, and a recomposition proof into a skill-mutation gate.

technique_overlays.trigger: The differential must be power-analyzed on real telemetry before any harness integration is planned; if it needs hundreds of runs per mutation it is impractical.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The repair stage runs a real power analysis on sigil-invocations.jsonl (and a simulated mutation slice), reports the runs needed to detect a residue-rate shift, and names the failure interpretation if detection is impractical or observer-contaminated.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Block if the prior DCI result and critique cannot be read.
Flag if the telemetry lacks any version-like or fixture-like key for a differential.

steps.name: Invoke Define the differential metric objective
stop_conditions: Block if the define does not state the observer-co-mutation threat as the make-or-break.
Flag if version tagging or fixed-workload control is left implicit.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review of the define
stop_conditions: Block if the differential is contaminated by observer co-mutation with no countermeasure.
Flag if the workload is not held fixed between v_old and v_new.

steps.name: Refine research decision
stop_conditions: Default to no-research; the differential is a local design question.
Ask the operator before any external pass on rare-event change-detection methods.

steps.name: Distill the coherent unit of comparison
convergence_criteria: The unit of comparison is one (skill_version, fixture-corpus) cell, with the residue signal and the version key named.
The observer-independent ground-truth signal set is named (git file-rework, fixture pass/fail, downstream failure).
Rejected comparison designs are recorded with the reason.
stop_conditions: Block if no version key can identify a mutation boundary.
Flag if no observer-independent ground-truth signal is available.

steps.name: Invoke Design the differential via tournament
convergence_criteria: Each design states its version-tagging, workload-control, scoring source, and observer-independence.
A pareto gate ranks the three on observer-independence, workload control, and cost.
The winning design proves recomposition into a concrete skill-mutation gate (run before/after a skill edit).
stop_conditions: Block if every design is observer-contaminated.
Flag if the tournament collapses to one design without recording the comparison.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review of the differential design
stop_conditions: Block if the winning design cannot detect a real mutation effect distinct from a reporting change.
Flag if the attribution window or version key is ambiguous.

steps.name: Distill Repair via power analysis on real telemetry
stop_conditions: Block if the differential cannot be computed on the real store at all.
Flag and record as assessment failure if detecting a residue-rate shift needs an impractical number of runs.

steps.name: Invoke Plan the skill-mutation gate (non-executed)
stop_conditions: Block if the plan implies editing canonical packages instead of proposing harness/observability/sigil-development configs.
Flag if the plan lacks the observer-independence solution or the minimum-runs threshold.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: Block if RESULT.md is synthesized from the route instead of the power analysis and stage artifacts.
Block if the verdict claims the metric makes sense without the observer-independence solution proven.
Flag if any open residue lacks an owner or next route.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The design stage is a tournament across three differential designs that differ mainly in observer-independence, plus a feasibility reviewer who must run a real power analysis to decide whether the differential is detectable at all.
subagent_strategy.explanation: One designer per differential keeps the ground-truth, harness-replay, and live-slice framings independent so the observer-independence comparison is fair; a separate feasibility reviewer runs the power analysis without a designer's optimism.
context: The prior DCI run failed as an absolute gauge for exactly the reasons (self-report, confound) that the differential framing must prove it escapes.
Residue is rare (~10% of records); detecting a mutation-induced shift may need many runs — only a real power analysis settles it.

roles.purpose: Design the observer-independent differential (git file-rework, fixture pass/fail, downstream failure) over a fixed-fixture replay.
Design the fixed-workload replay differential scored with the bundled observer, and state exactly where it stays contaminated.
Design the live version-slice differential and its weaknesses (no workload control, no observer freeze).
Run a real power analysis on the telemetry: how many runs to detect a residue-rate shift, and whether the effect separates from a reporting change.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the skill-mutation differential refine loop with three parallel differential designers (ground-truth, harness-replay, live-slice) and a power-analysis reviewer over the real signal store, returning ranked designs and a feasibility verdict only?
receipt_requirements: version-tagging, workload-control, scoring source, and observer-independence
power-analysis result: minimum runs to detect a residue-rate shift

agents.residue: Git-rework anchor is structurally observer-independent; weakness = trailing signal (post-hoc, not pre-merge).
Fixed-workload replay; cheap; but execution-prose can prime the bundled observer (confound no freeze/diff catches).
Cheapest; confounded by design (workload drift + observer co-mutation); valid only as a screening canary.
Verdict gross-regression-only-canary: Δ=0.20 needs 36 paired runs, available ~10; needs 50-100 fixtures/skill.

boundaries.contract: The winning differential design is a candidate until the power analysis shows the mutation effect is detectable and observer-independent.

The plan is a candidate replay + gate proposal; running mutations through the harness and integrating the gate is owned by experiment-harness, observability, and sigil-development, not this refine loop.

state_namespaces.write_policy: This refine run may write only inside its own run folder.
The signal store is read-only for this run; the power analysis reads it and writes results only into the run folder.
No edits to observability, experiment-harness, sigil-development, or sigil packages from this run; integration is a separate owner task.

promotion_splits.source: refine differential design and power-analysis evidence
promotion_splits.target: canonical observability envelope, experiment-harness, or sigil-development gate
promotion_splits.rule: requires owner review and a separate promotion route

gates.condition: Each runtime-backed stage must name an available native capability handle before execution, or block with the missing handle.
Each runtime-backed stage must record a stage receipt artifact path or an explicit blocked reason before it is marked complete.

The differential must separate a real mutation effect from a change in the skill's own reporting; a design that cannot is blocked, and the metric is declared not-sensible-as-built unless an observer-independent ground-truth signal is named.
A real power analysis on the telemetry must report the minimum runs to detect a residue-rate shift; if impractical, record as an assessment failure rather than claiming the metric works.
Stages may propose a candidate differential, an envelope field, and a replay config but must not edit canonical observability, experiment-harness, sigil-development, or sigil packages.
RESULT.md must be synthesized from the power analysis and stage artifacts, and must give an honest does-it-make-sense verdict, not a route restatement.

promotion_guardrails: Do not claim the differential makes sense unless observer co-mutation is cheaply neutralized by a named ground-truth signal.
Do not present a DCI shift as a real mutation effect without a fixed workload held between versions.
Do not treat the metric as detectable without a real power analysis on the telemetry.
Do not edit canonical observability, experiment-harness, sigil-development, or sigil packages from this run.
Do not execute the differential-designer or power-analysis subagents without explicit operator approval.
